```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Tower Grove South'
    AND wikipedia ILIKE '%St. Louis%'
)
, clipped_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM region_geom),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast,
    (SELECT geom FROM region_geom)
  )
)
, slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
  FROM clipped_raster
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS mean_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(slope_rast)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS dump;
```
